digest.component_or_area: plan review gate, AC close-gate logic
propositions: The regex _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE must be widened to match both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] spellings case-insensitively via a non-capturing alternation.

The regex change propagates to five consumers: decide_ops, workflow_ops, det_attestation_launder, det_measurement_provenance (normal matching) and txn.py:ensure_ac_boxes_checked (inverted semantics, removes lines from close-block set).
The non-capturing alternation is required to prevent findall() in operator_attested_ac_texts from returning tuples instead of strings, which would break Pass-3 enrichment.
An unchecked [non-codebase] AC line must become close-exempt via the inverted matcher in txn.py:547, matching the existing [operator-attested] exemption.
The .rebar/criteria_routing.json project.measurement-provenance trigger must fire on both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] tagged plans.
ADR 0101 must land first to define [non-codebase] vocabulary and record the decision before this matcher accepts it.
